title: Kidambi Srikanth Faces Lee Cheuk Yiu in China Masters Quarterfinals
indian_angle: Former World No. 1 Kidambi Srikanth is the sole Indian men's singles player in contention at the Super 750 event.
summary: Former World No. 1 Indian shuttler Kidambi Srikanth is set to compete in the men’s singles quarterfinal of the China Masters 2026, with live streaming details now available.

title: Satwik-Chirag and Srikanth Lead Indian Challenge in China Masters Quarterfinals
indian_angle: India's top men's doubles pair Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, along with Kidambi Srikanth, are carrying the nation's hopes in the China Masters quarterfinals.
summary: India's challenge at the Super 750 China Masters is alive with men’s singles player Kidambi Srikanth and men’s doubles pair Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty advancing to the quarterfinals today.

title: Srikanth Stuns Lai, Satwik-Chirag Advance at China Masters
indian_angle: Kidambi Srikanth secured a significant upset victory, and the formidable men's doubles pair of Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty also won their respective matches.
summary: Kidambi Srikanth, 33, rallied to defeat World Championships bronze medalist Lai 21-18, 21-19, while Satwik-Chirag also secured a win at the China Masters, though Tanvi suffered a loss.

title: BAI Announces Advanced Level-1 Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: This course is a key initiative by BAI to enhance the coaching standards and development of badminton talent across India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) is organizing a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur, scheduled from September 14 to 23, 2026.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: This coaching camp is vital for preparing India's promising young shuttlers for the upcoming Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships.
summary: A coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is underway at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.
